notes.title: Small fixes and New music.
notes.content:
Hello everyone. While testing for the new update featuring a new playable faction, we found some bugs that required fixing immediately. We also added a new song in sandbox mode by our talented composer Anthony Webb.

- Fixed a bug where enemy ships AI wouldn't start in a naval battle
- Fixed a bug where Maroon enemy units wouldn't spawn
- Fixed a transparency issue in slipway building
- Added a new song that will play in the overworld in sandbox mode

notes.title: Night Winds Update
notes.content:
Patch Notes


 Day and Night cycle: New ambient light changes during gameplay for increased immersion. Carries on through battles and city management mode.
 Wind Direction System: This new system implements wind direction which affects ship movement speed and changes as the battle goes on.
 Randomized Battle levels: In sandbox mode along with a preset of battle scenarios, there is a randomized map which changes the terrain features each time you play it.
 New UI: A new interface for the overworld city screen. New icons for most of the unit recruitment buttons. New Icons for ships in the shipyard. This is a work in progress as we will continue to implement more icons.

notes.title: Night winds update - work in progress
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41140987/0783eebe31a7b01b9439e72503804465a2c35631.png

Hello!

While we've been working on finishing the british faction buildings for the sandbox mode, we have been working on other features as well. We are currently testing this update and will release it in the coming days.

The update will feature the following:


 Wind direction system that affects ships movement: This is something we have been working on for a while and felt the game needed urgently in terms of it being a very important aspect in the age of sail and naval battles gameplay in general.
 Day and Night cycle during overworld gameplay, city building and battles in sandbox mode.
 New water shader. 
 Randomized terrain features in sandbox mode battles for more variety.



After this update we plan on releasing the british faction update as soon as we finish some details with their buildings.

Please join us on our discord channel, let's talk about what you want from FoA Tactics!

Thank you, for the support!

notes.title: Bugfixes
notes.content:
- Fixed an issue where workers would not keep their skill level after loading a game in sandbox mode

- Fixed an issue where starting a new game on sandbox mode would delete progress from the scenario campaigns

notes.title: The City Stats Update - New gameplay mechanic
notes.content:
Hello Governors! In this new update we are introducing a new gameplay feature. Happiness and city stats. Now you will have to make sure that your citizens are happy by taking care of their needs: Health, security, religion and entertainment.

By constructing different buildings around houses you will increase one of these stats, you have to keep your city happiness at least above half of the required number or you will face the consequences, such as an increased number of bandits in the area.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41140987/49aa9756fcce29e2d966924db83d4b51311d9069.png

You can see the stat each building will improve by taking a look at the tooltip when hovering over the construction icons. 

You can also see the area that is affected by selecting a building.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41140987/073941dc18f874347d5d85252549632d4f1cce82.png

We hope that this feature makes the city planning aspect more involved as you now will have to plan carefully where you put the different buildings.

Thank you for playing the game. Until the next update, see you soon!

notes.title: The Workers Update
notes.content:
Hello Governors! We hope this holiday season finds you well. We would like you to meet a new group of fellas who will be joining the you in this update. Meet the workers!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41140987/7aeb572aaf318d88fddca5973a588870ff7e16cc.png

Now every worker starts to gain some experience over time on a particular profession related to the place they work in. Eventually becoming experts and increasing the production of that facility.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41140987/b59b8d2a4713d65216d2e833aec9d40c109813c4.png

Also depending of the settlement, European, Maroon or Native. You will get an appropriate worker of that race.

We hope to bring some personality and attachment for the players to these loyal workers. Be sure to protect them from those pesky pirates or highwaymen.

See you soon for the next update where we will focus on the City Building gameplay.

Happy Holidays everyone
Jaime & Marcelo

Balandra

notes.title: Multiple armies update is here!
notes.content:
This update includes a much requested feature. You will now be able to control multiple armies and fleets. Among a host of other fixes and improvements

New Features
You will be able to have up to 4 armies and 4 fleets if you have the required gold. Unlocks available from the government screen. 


 Added events that will trigger under some circumstances. Including direct attacks by land or by sea
 AI cities will launch direct land attacks to enemy cities, including yours.
 You can now choose to start in a random city from your empire
 Added disband army button
 Added city unit cap and a warning when you reach it, Improved UI to show fleet and troop cap accordingly


Fixes

 Remove garrisoned worker from upkeep after building is destroyed by the enemy
 Fixed a bug where you could lose control of a city after a successful auto resolve victory
 Fixed a bug where after winning a battle and loading, the battle prompt would appear again 
 Fixed a bug where the battle prompt would stay or appear again after a naval siege
 Esc key will now show the main menu in the overworld


Check out our Devlog to see what we are working on. Stay tuned for the next update!

Devlog 2: Upcoming features

notes.title: Field of Arms: Tactics - Update: alpha version 1.62
notes.content:
Thanks to all who bought the game and for the intial feedback we've received. This update is meant to address some of the suggestions made by the community these first few weeks. Here are the patch notes.

Improved Camera controls
- Added smooth rotation with Q and E instead of fixed rotation angles (this also works when using unit cam)
- Added additional zoom controls: Hold shift key + mouse wheel to adjust camera FOV (a lot of people requested increased zoom levels, we hope you enjoy this option)
- Added Mouse edge scrolling 
- Tactical view hotkey: Press T on the keyboard to switch between any zoom level and tactical view

- Improved auto routes system
Previously you had to click select home city, then click on the city you wanted and do the same for the target city to establish your routes. Now a list with all the cities and towns you own will appear on the same menu you create your auto route for easy management in the same screen.

Other stuff
- Added background music to city building mode
- Added link to Development Survey in main menu
- Added Credits button in main menu
- Fixed a transparency bug in Slipway building
- Adjusted UI numbers size in trade screen

Starting a new game of sandbox mode is generally recommended after every update.

We hope that you continue to enjoy the game and don't forget to vote on the next features as this will be our guide for the development of the game.

notes.title: Naval battle Demo and new update
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we have now included a naval battle scenario in the demo among other features.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41140987/5f79c9b596b215701e04eee2affddcb433b5543f.png

Naval units improvements
We have been working on making naval units behave more like actual ships. Previously we were simulating naval movement on a plane. Now all naval units are actually floating on a water volume, with buoyancy and friction.

Changing sail speed will not happen instantly and instead will occur gradually, this also applies to dropping anchor. Players will have to take acceleration into account when maneuvering their ships. Ship turning is also affected by sail speed making bigger or closer circles to arrive at their destination. Each ship class has their own values of speed and turning.

The scale of the ships have been increased to a more realistic size, to keep a consistent size with the fortifications and environments. 

Health for all ships and fortifications was also increased, battles will take longer now.


Encyclopedia
The game now has an encyclopedia where you will find all the information about the units, their stats, and concepts of the game. This is a work in progress and is incomplete at the moment. Some units are missing and some documentation is not yet implemented in the game. We will continue to update it as we develop the game further.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41140987/2ec0c22d900b72738c64142c6ebc10a2bda12756.png

Multiplayer Coop (Highly experimental, NOT RECOMMENDED)
An experimental mode is now available to play in co-op with both players in control of the same army, in order to do this you need to start a mission with “online ON” from the scenario selection menu. Then from the main menu other players can join by IP. The hosting player needs to have ports UDP 7777 open. At this moment this is only intended for test purposes, expect crashes and many bugs. Test at your own risk.


General fixes and changes
Fixed bugs related to units not responding immediately to movement orders when they were engaged in combat and improved the conditions for when a unit returns fire when set to aggressive behavior.

Cannonball speed is increased for artillery, forts, and ships, making these units deadlier, more accurate and realistic.

We reverted back to a default camera view instead of the “tilt shift” visual effect as some players found it difficult to view clearly. If you still want to check out the miniature effect you can swap it by pressing Z on the keyboard.


Future updates
Work on our second campaign is going smoothly. It is a historical fiction setting where you will play as a pirate crew bent on capturing an island over the course of 9 missions. We worked hard on making the location believable, with many landmarks and different sectors, rural, industrial, agricultural with a lot of mission variety including landing operations. In this campaign you will have fewer units but larger battle areas than the “Battle of Cartagena” campaign. Our main goal before the Steam release is to have this campaign ready to increase our mission count to 20+

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41140987/24aa63e714d5550560df3576c84d9441cdc98d66.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41140987/54630e386754b2436fea91bba249a4f887992cfa.png



Sandbox mode
Further down the line, we are working on a sandbox mode where you will play as a governor in the caribbean. In this mode, players start with one capital city and they will have to explore to find resources, construct buildings to extract them, in order to further improve their city and battle against enemy empires competing for these resources and cities.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41140987/d2610f21cc94a72e2398f60fd6e76966482bc422.png


Thank you for playing the game and staying in contact with us. We keep a close eye on all your suggestions. Commander units are something we definitely want to implement. Special thanks to players Woos, Yggdrasil, Warriordude for your feedback.

notes.title: New demo and game update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

After taking in feedback from players and watching videos of people who played the demo, we want to show you the upcoming changes coming to the game, including an updated demo.

New unit behavior system
In our game, unit positioning and avoiding friendly fire forms the basis of the gameplay, initially we wanted the player to have complete control of where to move and who to attack but we realized many players expected units to behave as they do in traditional RTS games and have a greater degree of independence. With that in mind we implemented a behavior system in which you can choose how you want your units to behave.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41140987/241cad0873b72602d2be1426b0ad9e6154f22c38.png

Aggressive
After giving an attack order, units will chase the enemy until it is in range and proceed to attack it, if the enemy tries to retreat they will follow. They will also return fire when fired upon.

Defensive
Units stay in position and will not chase the enemy, they will fire from their position to any enemy within range.

Passive
Similar to our old system, units will not chase or respond to enemy fire, they will only follow orders given by the player. Useful when you want complete control


Scaling things up!
In order to bring up a more detailed environment and make locations feel more alive, we are scaling up all the vegetation and buildings in the game. This will allow players to see more details of all the assets while also having a standard size in relation to the fortresses, castles and units. This also impacts the play area and prepares us for the future when we implement a garrison system.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41140987/9187e687db78ff3967a9b24b470340634e6c9b4b.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41140987/44f593e25e23bd1e7de788f8c192cedc4720552e.png

Terrain detection improvements
We changed how units detect the terrain. We had been using trigger areas around the map to apply terrain bonuses, with the new system units detect the physical material of the landscape they are standing in and apply their respective changes to movement and defense. This helps quite a lot when designing new scenarios with increased freedom. This also allows us to assign values to every single type of material terrain in the map.

Ship sails feedback
When changing the sailing speed you will see it reflected on the ship models and on the interface.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41140987/10a811f844dde56f38b250c9797f02519d85a42e.png

Contested capture areas
Now you can only capture points when there aren’t any enemies nearby.

Better visual feedback from camp and logistics train
Both the player camp and logistics train will now display which unit is being healed.

Tilt shift effect
To further give the impression of miniatures we added a tilt shift visual effect, if you want to switch back to the normal mode you can press Z on the keyboard to flip between both modes.

New Campaign
We have also been working on a second campaign in order to bring up more value to our upcoming release. The campaign revolves around capturing an entire island with different sectors. We will be providing more info in the upcoming weeks.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41140987/798f993b95ca26e59c355cbe7b2ab70f9dd8c906.png

Thank you for reading and for following up the development of the game!
